attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_medical_document_processing_pipeline

steps:
  - id: authenticate_google_drive
    op: google_drive_auth
    params:
      method: service_account
      credentials_path: /secrets/gdrive_service_account.json
      scopes:
        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly
    output: gdrive_client

  - id: list_and_identify_new_pdfs
    op: google_drive_list_files
    params:
      client: "{{gdrive_client}}"
      folder_id: "{{env.GDRIVE_MEDICAL_FOLDER_ID}}"
      mime_type: application/pdf
      exclude_already_processed: true
      processed_manifest_path: ./state/processed_manifest.json
    output: new_pdf_list

  - id: download_pdfs
    op: google_drive_download_batch
    params:
      client: "{{gdrive_client}}"
      files: "{{new_pdf_list}}"
      destination_dir: ./tmp/downloads/
      read_only_source: true
    output: downloaded_pdf_paths

  - id: extract_text_and_hash
    op: pdf_text_extraction
    params:
      input_files: "{{downloaded_pdf_paths}}"
      primary_method: digital_extraction
      fallback_method: ocr_tesseract
      ocr_language: eng
      compute_hash: true
      hash_algorithm: sha256
    output: extracted_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, source_pdf, raw_text, sha256_hash, extraction_method }

  - id: anonymize_text
    op: pii_anonymization
    params:
      documents: "{{extracted_documents}}"
      entities_to_redact:
        - doctor_names
        - hospital_names
        - addresses
        - phone_numbers
        - email_addresses
      token_format: "[REDACTED_{entity_type}_{index}]"
      preserve:
        - clinical_values
        - lab_results
        - medication_dosages
        - dates_clinical
        - numeric_measurements
      mapping_output_path: ./tmp/anonymization_mappings/
      audit_log: true
    output: anonymized_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, anonymized_text, pii_mapping, sha256_hash, source_pdf }

  - id: structure_to_markdown
    op: ai_markdown_structuring
    params:
      documents: "{{anonymized_documents}}"
      primary_model: "{{env.PRIMARY_AI_MODEL}}"
      fallback_model: "{{env.FALLBACK_AI_MODEL}}"
      prompt_template: ./templates/medical_document_structuring.prompt
      use_fallback_on_verification_failure: true
      max_retries: 2
      output_format: markdown
    output: structured_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, markdown_content, model_used, anonymized_text, sha256_hash, source_pdf }

  - id: verify_content_integrity
    op: content_verification
    params:
      documents: "{{structured_documents}}"
      checks:
        - type: numeric_preservation
          description: "All numbers from source appear unchanged in Markdown"
        - type: date_preservation
          description: "All dates from source appear unchanged in Markdown"
        - type: clinical_value_preservation
          description: "All clinical values intact"
      compare_source_field: anonymized_text
      compare_target_field: markdown_content
      confidence_levels:
        high: all_checks_pass
        medium: minor_discrepancies
        low: any_check_fails
    output: verified_documents
    # Each item adds: { confidence, verification_report }

  - id: route_by_confidence
    op: conditional_split
    params:
      input: "{{verified_documents}}"
      condition_field: confidence
      routes:
        - match: low
          output_key: low_confidence_docs
        - match_any: [high, medium]
          output_key: approved_docs
    output:
      low_confidence_docs: low_confidence_docs
      approved_docs: approved_docs

  - id: enqueue_low_confidence_for_review
    op: review_queue_append
    params:
      documents: "{{low_confidence_docs}}"
      queue_path: ./state/review_queue.json
      include_fields:
        - source_pdf
        - sha256_hash
        - confidence
        - verification_report
        - model_used
      timestamp: true
      audit_log: true
    output: review_queue_entries

  - id: write_markdown_and_metadata
    op: file_write_batch
    params:
      documents: "{{approved_docs}}"
      markdown_output_dir: ./raw/
      markdown_filename_template: "{{source_pdf.name | replace('.pdf', '.md')}}"
      metadata_output_dir: ./raw/
      metadata_filename_template: "{{source_pdf.name | replace('.pdf', '.meta.json')}}"
      metadata_fields:
        - sha256_hash
        - source_pdf
        - extraction_method
        - model_used
        - confidence
        - verification_report
        - processing_timestamp
      overwrite: false
    output: written_files

  - id: authenticate_git
    op: git_auth
    params:
      method: ssh_key
      ssh_key_path: "{{env.GIT_SSH_KEY_PATH}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
    output: git_session

  - id: commit_documents
    op: git_commit_batch
    params:
      session: "{{git_session}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
      files: "{{written_files}}"
      commit_message_template: "Add processed medical document: {{filename}} [confidence={{confidence}}] [hash={{sha256_hash}}]"
      author_name: medical-doc-pipeline
      author_email: "{{env.PIPELINE_GIT_EMAIL}}"
    output: pending_commits

  - id: push_on_threshold
    op: conditional_git_push
    params:
      session: "{{git_session}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
      pending_commits: "{{pending_commits}}"
      push_every_n_documents: 10
      remote: origin
      branch: main
      force: false
      push_remaining_at_end: true
    output: push_results

  - id: cleanup_tmp
    op: directory_cleanup
    params:
      directories:
        - ./tmp/downloads/
        - ./tmp/anonymization_mappings/
      recursive: true
      ignore_errors: false
    output: cleanup_status

  - id: write_run_log
    op: log_entry_write
    params:
      log_path: ./logs/pipeline_runs.jsonl
      entry:
        run_id: "{{run.id}}"
        timestamp: "{{run.timestamp}}"
        total_new_pdfs_found: "{{new_pdf_list | length}}"
        total_downloaded: "{{downloaded_pdf_paths | length}}"
        total_extracted: "{{extracted_documents | length}}"
        total_anonymized: "{{anonymized_documents | length}}"
        total_structured: "{{structured_documents | length}}"
        total_approved: "{{approved_docs | length}}"
        total_sent_to_review: "{{low_confidence_docs | length}}"
        total_committed: "{{pending_commits | length}}"
        total_pushed: "{{push_results.pushed_count}}"
        cleanup_status: "{{cleanup_status}}"
        errors: "{{run.errors}}"
    output: run_log_entry
